acceptance_gate.condition: collapse_detected_deploy_arm == false AND collapse_detected_control == true AND pass_rate_vs_true_accuracy_distinct_assert == true
acceptance_gate.principle: Self-learning is validated only when the guarded arm holds, the control collapses, and the two metrics are genuinely distinct (not a tautology).

field_principles.calibration_improved: Brier/ECE before vs after online adaptation.
field_principles.collapse_detected_control: Positive control: the naive online arm must collapse, else the test has no contrast.
field_principles.collapse_detected_deploy_arm: The conservative-default + uncertainty-gated rule must prevent fusion-weight collapse (alpha_t grounding).
field_principles.inference_substrate: Scores cached traces; no LLM load.
field_principles.online_fusion_auroc_gain: The forward difference -- does online fusion-weight learning beat a fixed 50/50 fusion?
field_principles.pass_rate_vs_true_accuracy_distinct_asse: De-flags the tautology where pass_rate and true_accuracy are the same array.
field_principles.quality_maintained: Collapse-prevention must not come at the cost of detector quality.

inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates (principle: scores cached traces; no LLM load).
